parent: design/BRad-RQ_v3.json, whose measurements closed the easy exits: the encoder's direction effective rank fell 1.72 -> 1.03, level-1 codes 211 -> 15, and the reconstruction objective had a floor of 2.07e-04 (predicting the global mean of the 768-d Stage1 embeddings) against a reached 1.79e-04, so the loss was nearly vacuous
purpose: make the three degenerate states simultaneously unreachable in practice: one direction for every item, one code for the first level, and a first level that is behaviourally arbitrary

mechanism.behaviour_radius: unchanged from v3: the training-only context-entropy rank sets the tangent radius, in equal-mass buckets whose count follows the frozen level-1 codebook size
mechanism.assignment: unchanged: the nearest codeword under the Poincare kernel at every level, in training, initialisation and export; no Sinkhorn
mechanism.prefix_centroid: mu_{P_l(i)} = the Frechet mean of the item points of all items that share prefix P_l(i), recomputed each epoch from the current hard assignment
mechanism.history_point: u_h = the Frechet mean of the FROZEN #126 reference's source representations of the items in the user's training history

L_VQ.rule: the baseline quantizer's own codebook and commitment terms, unchanged

L_sem.rule: MSE(decoder(t_hat), x - mean_train), with mean_train the mean of the training embeddings, frozen once
L_sem.why: predicting the uncentred embedding has a 2.07e-04 floor from the mean alone; centring removes that shortcut
L_sem.weight: 1 / (its value on the first measured batch), frozen at that value

L_beh.rule: mean over levels of softplus(-Delta_l) with Delta_l = d_H^2(u_h, mu_{P_l(i-)}) - d_H^2(u_h, mu_{P_l(i+)}), evaluated in the frozen #126 reference's geometry

levels.L1: global hard negatives: same radius bucket and same popularity band as the positive, different item
levels.L2: negatives that share the positive's L1 prefix
levels.L3: negatives that share the positive's L1 and L2 prefixes

L_beh.weight: 1 / (its value on the first measured batch), frozen at that value
L_beh.why_it_cannot_be_satisfied_by_a_collapse: with one L1 code for every item the two prefix centroids coincide, Delta_1 = 0 and the L1 term is softplus(0) = 0.693 for every pair: the collapse is the worst case of this term, not its solution

L_anti.direction_term: mean over dimensions of [max(0, gamma - std(z_hat[:, j]))]^2 plus the squared off-diagonal covariance of z_hat
L_anti.gamma: the mean per-dimension standard deviation of the encoder directions at initialisation, measured once on the first batch and frozen
L_anti.usage_term: [max(0, ln(K/2) - H_1)]^2 with H_1 the entropy of the level-1 hard assignment
L_anti.usage_floor: ln(K/2): at least half of the level-1 codebook must be effectively used
L_anti.weight: 1 / (its value on the first measured batch), frozen at that value
L_anti.why: the variance term is positive exactly when the directions collapse, and the usage term is positive exactly when the hard assignment concentrates

switches.behaviour_off: every item gets the median radius; the behaviour ranking loss and the behavioural negatives are computed but multiplied by zero; the geometry and the anti-collapse terms are unchanged
switches.geometry_off: the exponential map is the identity and the score is the squared Euclidean distance on the tangents; the behaviour ranking loss keeps its hyperbolic geometry? NO: with the map removed there is no ball, so the behaviour ranking term is computed in the same reference geometry and is multiplied by zero, and the anti-collapse terms stay
switches.both_on: the full mechanism; the only arm that is trained (section 19g)

frozen_inputs.leakage: no validation or test interaction is read; the reference was trained on the train pairs only

inertness_conditions: if all encoder directions are forced equal, the direction term must rise and its gradient must separate them
if all L1 codes are forced equal, the L1 behaviour term cannot fall and the usage term cannot fall
if the L1 assignment is high-usage but behaviourally random, the behaviour term must not reward it
if the behaviour signal is switched off, the behaviour term must not reach the encoder
if the geometry is switched off, the hyperbolic path must not be used
if the soft proxy and the hard assignment disagree in the one-hot limit, the training path is not the export path

acceptance.tests: one test per inertness condition, each driving the real functions
acceptance.verification: the V2 record carries this contract's version and sha256
acceptance.final: Stage 3 test_recall@10 from the single frozen run, against 0.055537 for the baseline and 0.065 for the target
acceptance.diagnostics: direction effective rank, per-level active codes and perplexity, per-level behaviour ranking accuracy, prefix centroid movement, dead-code resets -- recorded, never an admission gate
